containers.title: Enterprise Managed Containers
containers.description: List of containers pre-configured and enforced by enterprise policy.

name.description: Display name of the container (e.g. 'Corporate SSO').

color.description: Container color name (blue, navy, sky, teal, mint, green, lime, yellow, amber, orange, coral, red, crimson, pink, magenta, purple, indigo, slate, grey) or #RRGGBB hex code.

icon.description: Container icon key (e.g. briefcase, shield, lock, cloud, code, bank, fingerprint).

isolated.description: If true, limits this container strictly to its designated sites and opens non-designated sites in Default.

siteAssignments.title: Enterprise Site-to-Container Assignments
siteAssignments.description: List of domain or wildcard rules (e.g. '*.corp.example.com') mapped to a target container ID.

containerId.description: Target container ID to open matching URLs in.

disableTemporaryContainers.title: Disable Temporary Containers
disableTemporaryContainers.description: If true, disables disposable Temporary/Burner containers.

allowUserContainers.title: Allow User-Created Containers
allowUserContainers.description: If false, prevents users from creating or deleting custom containers.
